facts.fact: National Treasury and the Presidency's Operation Vulindlela Phase II Q1 2026/27 progress report, released 31 July 2026, reports implementation of the Digital Transformation Roadmap through milestones on MyMzansi, MzansiXchange, digital identity, payments and interoperability standards, without measuring progress against any target stated in the Roadmap.
facts.system: Roadmap for the Digital Transformation of Government

facts.fact: The same report lists dated next steps for the Roadmap work, due September 2026, November 2026 and March 2027, with no cost stated.
